hero.headline: Build confidence in Math, French & English.
hero.subhead: Tailored one-on-one sessions for students at every level — from elementary school through university.

intro.title: Academic Excellence
intro.text: With over 4 years of experience tutoring, I am passionate about helping students achieve their academic goals. I specialize in Mathematics, French, and English, offering personalized tutoring sessions tailored to each student's unique learning style.

philosophy.title: Teaching Philosophy
philosophy.text: My teaching philosophy centers on building strong foundations while making learning enjoyable. I help students at any level—whether improving grades, conquering homework, or deeply grasping concepts.

background.title: Background & Credentials
background.text: Currently studying finance at a top university in Canada. I have experience working with a wide range of students, from elementary to university level. I aim to instill a lifelong love of learning not limited solely by academic success.

personalTouch.quote: Growing up I had many tutors of my own, so I have a deep understanding of what it means to be a student. I use my direct knowledge of teaching to make sure my students understand concepts, and achieve their true potential.
personalTouch.author: Daniel
